page: Microsoft Azure M64bds_v3 is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C processor running at 4.0 GHz. It features 64 virtual CPUs across 32 physical cores with hyper-threading and a 105 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 512 GB of RAM, providing an 8.0 GB per core memory ratio, alongside 410 GB of local storage.

Benchmark results indicate strong capabilities across memory and compute tasks. The server achieves top-tier status in Geekbench single-core, image processing, and text processing tests. Memory bandwidth is also highly rated, placing in the top 25% for both cached small-block and uncached large-block read operations. Multi-core performance, software compilation, and database operations consistently rank in the top 25% of tested hardware.

Given the high memory density and dedicated compute resources, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require GPU acceleration. The combination of 512 GB RAM, high-speed Intel Xeon cores, and local storage makes it highly suitable for large relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, and enterprise-level data processing pipelines.
